tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild normocytic, normochromic anemia with slightly low hemoglobin and hematocrit. Erythrocyte count is mildly elevated, possibly reflecting compensation. Platelet count is normal, but both mean platelet volume and distribution width are increased, suggesting platelet activation or regeneration. Leukocyte count is within normal limits. Correlation with clinical context and further evaluation for anemia and platelet changes is recommended.

display.value: Localized, primary osteoarthritis of the hand
